class_size_limits_001.evidence: The Union recognizes that the Board has the authority to establish staffing targets for non-core curricula classes. If the Union believes that the staffing targets are exceeded, the appropriate Executive Director will be notified and will work with the Union to address possible solutions.
class_size_limits_001.coder_notes: Stage 1 incorrectly coded as not_discussed. Article 10.F explicitly outlines a review procedure for staffing targets, requiring notification and collaboration to address solutions if exceeded.
